needsBespoke.why: Powder Keg (E) does not fit any single primitive cleanly: it is placed on a location as a distinct entity with its own hit points (3 health, decaying over time), must then be destroyed by a separate basic attack or Parrrley cast from Gangplank to explode, and that triggering attack's own damage (including on-hit/Spellblade effects but not on-hit proc damage) becomes the explosion's base damage, plus a flat bonus vs champions, with a chain-reaction to other nearby kegs each on a 0.3s (or bin's 0.5s) delay. This is a two-stage cast-then-destroy pet/trap mechanic with damage-forwarding from the triggering attack, which is not captured by weapon-or-ammo-system, pet-or-summon, or recast-or-multipart alone. A bespoke rule is needed: place keg -> attack keg with a normal attack or Q -> that attack's damage (plus champion bonus, minus armor pen) is dealt as keg explosion damage, with the placing attack itself also dealing its own damage to the dummy directly (double-dip), and chains only relevant if multiple kegs are placed and clustered (a positional assumption the dummy fight must decide).

proposal: Pre-fight: place a Powder Keg near the dummy if a charge is available (does not cost time in the fight, keg has 25s lifetime), to set up an instant Trial by Fire refresh once destroyed.
Open by casting Cannon Barrage (R) on the dummy's location immediately (long cooldown, cast early to maximize uptime of its 12 magic-damage waves across the fight duration).
Immediately follow with Parrrley (Q) on cooldown throughout the fight (4.5s cooldown, cheap enough on mana budget) as the primary repeated damage source.
Whenever Trial by Fire is off cooldown, weave a basic attack (or let auto-attacks naturally continue) into the Q rotation so the empowered burn attack fires immediately once available.

Attack the placed Powder Keg (via basic attack or Parrrley) as soon as convenient to detonate it, dealing the triggering attack's damage plus the champion bonus damage, and to reset Trial by Fire's cooldown for another proc.
Re-place and re-detonate Powder Kegs whenever a charge is available and it does not delay Q/auto-attack casts, to keep resetting Trial by Fire and adding extra explosion damage instances.
Continue basic-attacking between Q casts (respecting its cast time and the attack timer) to maximize total auto-attack damage and Trial by Fire uptime.
Do not cast Remove Scurvy (W) in the damage fight since it only heals/cleanses and has no damage-fight contribution; only relevant in the survival fight as periodic self-healing on cooldown.
